plugins.name: vectorlab-ux-skills
plugins.description: VectorLab UI/UX, microcopy, and visual taste skills: low-friction, high-taste interfaces for any frontend stack.

skills.name: motion
skills.description: Defines duration tokens, easing, and which properties may animate. Use when adding CSS transitions, keyframes, motion tokens, or reviewing decorative animation.
skills.description_zh: 定义动画时长令牌、缓动及可动画属性，适用于CSS过渡、关键帧、动效令牌及装饰动画审查。

skills.name: reduced-motion
skills.description: Honors prefers-reduced-motion with instant or opacity-only fallbacks. Use when adding animation, transitions, parallax, autoplay, or accessibility motion work.
skills.description_zh: 遵循prefers-reduced-motion，以即时或仅透明度变化回退，处理动画、过渡、视差、自动播放及动态无障碍。

skills.name: transitions
skills.description: Enter/exit patterns for overlays and lists without layout jump. Use when animating drawers, dialogs, popovers, route changes, or staggered lists.
skills.description_zh: 为抽屉、弹窗、popover、路由和交错列表设计无布局跳动的进入退出过渡。

skills.name: ux-audit
skills.description: Audits the current UI working set against every installed VectorLab UX skill. Use before finishing UI work, when the user asks for a UX audit, pre-flight, or taste audit, or when reviewing a screen for skill compliance.
headings: 3. Detect install root and discover domain skills
8. Report (chat only — no file on disk)
skills.description_zh: 按所有已安装VectorLab UX技能审计当前UI改动，适用于完成前检查、UX或审美评审及技能规范核查。

skills.name: empty-states
skills.description: Builds actionable empty and filtered-zero states with clear CTAs. Use when building empty views, onboarding zeros, or no-search-results screens.
skills.description_zh: 为无数据、首次使用及筛选搜索零结果界面建立明确行动按钮和可操作空状态。

skills.name: loaders
skills.description: Chooses loaders by duration — none under 100ms, inline to 1s, skeletons beyond. Use when adding spinners, skeletons, async fetches, or fixing flicker.
skills.description_zh: 按原文时长规则选择加载反馈：不足100毫秒无加载器，一秒以内内联，超过用骨架屏；用于异步加载、spinner及闪烁修复。

skills.name: defaults
skills.description: Intelligent defaults and draft persistence so users avoid blank busywork. Use when designing forms, dropdowns, preferences, or saving draft state across routes.
skills.description_zh: 设计智能默认值及草稿持久化，减少空白重复录入，适用于表单、下拉、偏好及跨路由草稿。

skills.name: forms
skills.description: Blur-first validation, instant error clear, fewer fields, clickable submit. Use when building forms, inputs, wizards, or fixing validation UX.
skills.description_zh: 改善表单验证体验，以失焦优先验证、立即清除已修正错误、减少字段及可点击提交，适用于输入和向导。

skills.name: icon-buttons
skills.description: Collapses labeled toolbar controls to square icon buttons with required tooltips and shortcut kbd. Use when building toolbars, icon-only buttons, view toggles, export/filter/columns chrome, or reviewing icon button a11y.
skills.description_zh: 把工具栏带标签控件收成方形图标按钮，配必要tooltip及快捷键kbd，适用于视图、导出筛选列控制及图标按钮无障碍检查。

skills.name: keyboard
skills.description: Full keyboard access, visible focus rings, and focus trap/restore for overlays. Use when building interactive UI, modals, shortcuts, or accessibility focus work.
skills.description_zh: 实现完整键盘访问、可见焦点环及覆盖层焦点捕获恢复，适用于交互UI、modal、快捷键和无障碍。

skills.name: page-patterns
skills.description: Names one locked page pattern (list, detail, form, dashboard, settings, board, calendar, split pane, analytics, inbox) before any new page is built. Use when creating a screen, route, layout, dashboard, settings page, list, form page, inbox, calendar, board, or marketing landing.
skills.description_zh: 新页面开发前确定并固定列表、详情、表单、仪表板、设置、看板、日历、分栏、分析或收件箱等页面模式，指导屏幕路由及布局选择。

skills.name: surfaces
skills.description: Routes tasks to inline edit, slide-over, or a page; requires named destructive confirmation and zero layout shift on single-field edits. Use when adding modals, drawers, dialogs, routes, inline rename, contenteditable cells, or destructive actions.
skills.description_zh: 按任务选择内联编辑、侧滑层或独立页面，为破坏性操作提供明确命名确认并保证单字段编辑无布局偏移，适用于弹窗、抽屉、重命名及可编辑单元格。

skills.name: setup-ui-ux-skills
skills.description: Configure this repo for VectorLab UI/UX skills: aesthetic reference, banned anti-patterns, accessibility target, microcopy voice, and icon library. Run once before first use of the other UX skills.
skills.name_hint: 设置 · ui · ux · 技能
skills.description_zh: 首次使用其他VectorLab UX技能前，为仓库配置审美参考、禁止模式、无障碍目标、微文案语气及图标库。

skills.name: anti-slop
skills.description: Rejects glassmorphism, rainbow CTAs, cartoon empty states, and SaaS visual clutter. Use when reviewing AI-generated UI, polishing visuals, or removing decorative noise.
skills.description_zh: 审查AI生成UI及视觉润色，排除玻璃拟态、彩虹行动按钮、卡通空状态和SaaS视觉杂乱，减少装饰噪声。

skills.name: colour-palette
skills.description: Applies 60-30-10 colour distribution and elevation via borders then soft shadows. Use when choosing surfaces, accents, borders, shadows, or dark-mode depth.

skills.name: spacing
skills.description: Enforces optical alignment, 4/8pt spatial rhythm, and container/line-length constraints. Use when laying out screens, aligning icons to text, setting spacing, or reviewing uneven whitespace.

skills.name: typography
skills.description: Defines typographic scales, weight limits, and line-height pairing. Use when setting type styles, headings, body copy sizes, or fixing noisy type hierarchies.

skills.name: viewports
skills.description: Keeps layouts usable from 375px to 1280px: no page overflow, collapsed chrome, profile touch targets, and tap-first actions. Use when building or reviewing any page, layout, chrome, sidebar, table, or overlay that renders in a browser.

skills.name: errors
skills.description: Writes error copy that never blames the user and always offers recovery. Use when writing errors, toasts, failure states, or support-facing messages.

skills.name: labels
skills.description: Requires visible labels on every input; placeholders only for format hints. Use when building form fields, fixing a11y labeling, or reviewing placeholders.

skills.name: verbs
skills.description: Enforces verb-first CTA and button labels; bans OK, Submit, and Proceed. Use when writing buttons, links, menus, or reviewing UI microcopy.
